pages.title: Read the situation
pages.instruction: Read for the facts and the different priorities
pages.author: Scenario briefing · fictional
pages.subject: The apartment, which has a balcony
paragraphs: Fictional housing brief: works from home two days weekly; needs a usable work area; firm total monthly budget under $1,000. A: $900 total, near metro, compact work corner. B: $850 total, twenty minutes from metro, separate room. C: $950 advertised rent, ten minutes away, balcony and work corner, fee unconfirmed.

pages.title: Start with the brief
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Which apartment would you recommend for this brief?
lines.audioText: Which apartment would you recommend for this brief?
lines.translation: Qual apartamento você recomendaria para este perfil?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: The person who works from home needs a usable work area, but location matters too
lines.audioText: The person who works from home needs a usable work area, but location matters too.
lines.translation: A pessoa que trabalha de casa precisa de espaço para trabalhar, mas a localização também importa

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: A is near the metro. B has more space, although it’s further away
lines.audioText: A is near the metro. B has more space, although it’s further away.
lines.translation: O A é perto do metrô. O B tem mais espaço, embora fique mais longe

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: And C, which has a balcony, is between them in terms of distance
lines.audioText: And C, which has a balcony, is between them in terms of distance.
lines.translation: E o C, que tem varanda, fica entre os dois em termos de distância

questions.cue: Name two criteria from the brief
questions.answer: A usable work area and total budget under $1,000

pages.title: Check the missing cost
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Is the balcony essential or just attractive?
lines.audioText: Is the balcony essential or just attractive?
lines.translation: A varanda é essencial ou só atraente?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Attractive. The fixed requirements are a work area and a total budget under a thousand
lines.audioText: Attractive. The fixed requirements are a work area and a total budget under a thousand.
lines.translation: Atraente. Os requisitos fixos são espaço para trabalhar e orçamento total abaixo de mil

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Do all the listings include the maintenance fee?
lines.audioText: Do all the listings include the maintenance fee?
lines.translation: Todos os anúncios incluem a taxa de manutenção?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: A and B state a total. C’s listing doesn’t confirm the fee
lines.audioText: A and B state a total. C’s listing doesn’t confirm the fee.
lines.translation: O A e o B informam um total. O anúncio do C não confirma a taxa

questions.prompt: Why is C not fully comparable yet?
questions.answer: The maintenance fee is not confirmed

pages.title: A recommendation with a caveat
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Then we shouldn’t compare the advertised rents as if they were the full costs
lines.audioText: Then we shouldn’t compare the advertised rents as if they were the full costs.
lines.translation: Então não devemos comparar os aluguéis anunciados como se fossem os custos totais

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Agreed. I’d arrange a viewing of A and ask C’s landlord about the missing fee
lines.audioText: Agreed. I’d arrange a viewing of A and ask C’s landlord about the missing fee.
lines.translation: Concordo. Eu marcaria uma visita ao A e perguntaria ao proprietário do C sobre a taxa

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Would B still be an alternative if the commute were manageable?
lines.audioText: Would B still be an alternative if the commute were manageable?
lines.translation: O B continuaria sendo uma alternativa se o trajeto fosse viável?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes. It offers more space, which could matter more than being right by the metro
lines.audioText: Yes. It offers more space, which could matter more than being right by the metro.
lines.translation: Sim. Oferece mais espaço, o que pode importar mais do que ficar ao lado do metrô

questions.answer: It has more space, if the longer commute is acceptable

pages.title: The advertised rent wasn’t the total
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana. The landlord has confirmed that apartment C has a maintenance fee of one hundred and fifty dollars a month, on top of the nine hundred and fifty rent. That takes the total to eleven hundred, above the profile’s firm thousand-dollar limit. The balcony is still appealing, but it doesn’t remove the budget constraint. A and B haven’t changed. Could you revise the recommendation, explain which detail changes it and ask which of the remaining trade-offs matters more? We still need to see whether the work corner in A is comfortable enough for two home-working days a week
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana. The landlord has confirmed that apartment C has a maintenance fee of one hundred and fifty dollars a month, on top of the nine hundred and fifty rent.
